title: Alembic Basics 🕰
ques: What command line instruction do you run to automatically generate a new Alembic migration script based on changes in your SQLAlchemy models?
explanation: The `--autogenerate` flag tells Alembic to compare the current database state against your models and generate the required SQL.

title: Applying Migrations 🏗
ques: What command applies all pending Alembic migrations to update the database to the latest version?
explanation: `upgrade head` applies all unapplied migration scripts up to the most recent one.

title: ACID Properties 🧪
ques: Briefly describe the **Isolation** property in database transactions.

answer.content: **Isolation** ensures that concurrent transactions occur independently without interfering with each other. It guarantees that the intermediate state of a transaction is invisible to other transactions.

explanation: ACID (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) guarantees reliable processing of database transactions.
